text: 17-year-old male. The patient presents with a 3-day history of pain in his left wrist, which worsened this morning accompanied by chills and malaise. speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Lyme disease (Borrelia burgdorferi infection).
The combination of a recent Minnesota camping trip, a prior self-resolving migratory joint pain, and acute onset of fever, chills, and localized wrist pain is highly suggestive of Lyme arthritis with potential tenosynovitis.
